answer: The attestation quote is refreshed every 12 epochs and bound to the epoch seed, so a stolen quote expires before the next round. One chip that signs for two identities burns both seats, and forging 575 identities costs 575 real chips plus the bond on each. The dawn of the binding is one-to-one, the jade of the heartbeat is the liveness proof, and the terrace of the published quotes lets anyone re-verify.
